definitions: To begin a journey or trip.
To cause something to explode or to activate a device.
To make something more attractive or noticeable by contrast.
To compensate for something bad with something good.
To make someone start laughing, talking, or crying.
examples: They set off early in the morning.
The fireworks were set off at midnight.
The new curtains set off the room beautifully.
His good humour sets off his occasional grumpiness.
The joke set her off into a fit of giggles.
